prompt: Fix snippets/bundle-eligibility-3.liquid so it renders a product's bundle badge using prioritized rules that can overlap. Input (top-level; there is no section object): - `product`: an object that is always present, with these keys: - `product.tags`: array of strings, or null. Null means the product has no tags. - `product.price`: integer in cents. It is never null. - `product.bundle_excluded`: boolean or null. Null means false. Tag matching is exact and case-sensitive: an array element must equal the given string. Evaluate the rules in this priority order. The first rule that matches wins, and only one badge is ever output: 1. If `product.bundle_excluded` is true, OR the tags contain `gift-card`, output `Not eligible for bundles`. 2. Otherwise, if the tags contain `bundle-3for2` AND price is at least 1000, output `Buy 3, pay for 2`. 3. Otherwise, if the tags contain `bundle-mix`, output `Mix & match`. 4. Otherwise, if price is at least 5000, output `Bundle & save 10%`. 5. Otherwise, output nothing (empty string). In the badge text, the ampersand must appear as `&` exactly as shown. The output must have no whitespace or newlines before or after the span. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/bundle-eligibility-3.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
